Men of the sea are always spoiling for a good fight!
Hm? This is no place for playing.
quote.defeat: Ah! I can see that you're serious.

quote.pre: Sailors are both kind and strong. How about you?
quote.defeat: You are both kind and strong…

quote.pre: I travel the world to train my Poké- MON. I wish to battle with you.
Why are you here? Are you just going to gawk? I suggest that you leave!
JASMINE must be worried sick about the PokéMON here. She won't even smile these days.
quote.defeat: I can't manage a smile either…

quote.pre: JASMINE is this city's GYM LEADER. I mean to bring her back with me. Nobody had better get in my way!
I wanted to battle JASMINE, but she's not up to it now. So, how about you?
We're pretty high up here. My bird PokéMON are in prime form.
The trainers of this GYM use rock- type PokéMON. The rock-type has high DEFENSE. Battles could end up going a long time. Are you ready for this?
quote.defeat: I have to win these battles…

quote.pre: We've finally taken over the RADIO TOWER! Now everyone will get to experience the true terror of TEAM ROCKET! We'll show you how scary we are!
quote.defeat: Too strong! We must watch you…

quote.pre: Three years ago, TEAM ROCKET was forced to disband. But we're making a comeback here!
We're TEAM ROCKET, the exploiters of PokéMON! We love being evil! Scared?
Hey, hey! Keep out of our way!
Hahaha! How boring. It was far too easy to take over this place! Come on, keep me amused!
I've been given strict orders. I'm to crush any- one who challenges TEAM ROCKET!
It feels great ordering PokéMON to commit crimes.
Why did the shut- ter open? Did you have something to do with this?
An unknown child wandering here? Who are you?
quote.defeat: Tch! I took you too lightly!

quote.pre: You plan to rescue the DIRECTOR? That won't be pos- sible because I'm going to beat you!
Stop! I'm known as the TEAM ROCKET fortress! You're not taking another step!
Don't I think PokéMON are cute? I'll think my PokéMON are cute-- after they beat yours!
Most excellent. This RADIO TOWER will fulfill our grand design.
quote.defeat: Hmmm… All grand plans come with snags.

quote.pre: Hi, little boy. Remember me from the HIDEOUT in MAHOGANY TOWN? I lost then, but I won't this time.
quote.defeat: This can't be happening! I fought hard, but I still lost…

quote.pre: If trainers meet, the first thing to do is battle.
quote.defeat: Awww… I've got a losing record…

quote.pre: You there! Want to battle?
Hahahah!
You like PokéMON, don't you? Me too!
quote.defeat: I'd have to say that's my loss.

quote.pre: There's no cheat- ing in PokéMON. Let's keep it fair and square!
It itches and tickles a bit when I wear shorts in the grass.
I can see it… Everything to see about you…
Patience is the key to both fish- ing and PokéMON.
I feel so content, fishing while lis- tening to some tunes on my radio.
What's most impor- tant in our every- day lives?
quote.defeat: The answer is coming up next!

quote.pre: Do you remember?
Agility is the key attribute of bird PokéMON.
quote.defeat: You beat me with your speed…

quote.pre: Check out my Poké- MON. Just look at their coloring and their plumage.
Nihihi! Would you like to battle my PIKACHU gang?
I should go to ROCK TUNNEL to get myself an ONIX.
Bow down before my regal PokéMON!
quote.defeat: How… How dare you mock royalty!

quote.pre: Let me tell you, I had a hard time catching my prized PokéMON.
My dream is to fly with my beloved bird PokéMON.
quote.defeat: I can dream, but I can't ever fly…

quote.pre: Did you battle all the GYM trainers?
quote.defeat: Oh, wow! Too strong for me!

quote.pre: Hang on. I have to phone my Mom.
Let's battle. I won't lose!
quote.defeat: I forgot to do my homework!

quote.pre: We're on a field trip to LAVENDER RADIO TOWER for social studies.
My favorite class is gym!
quote.defeat: Oh, no! How could I lose?

quote.pre: Have you forgotten anything?
On sunny days, I think that the kids would rather be playing in the schoolyard than studying in class.
Hey, you! You're from JOHTO, huh?
Wow. That's a cool BICYCLE!
quote.defeat: But you don't just look cool…

quote.pre: Hey! Want to have a speed battle?
We're fearless highway stars!
If you're looking for PokéMON, you have to look in the tall grass.
CYCLING ROAD is a quick shortcut to CELADON.
I'm disgusted by wimpy people!
quote.defeat: I could beat you at swimming…

quote.pre: Have you ever gone swimming in the sea at night?
Swimming? I'm lousy at it. I'm just splashing around in these shallow waters.
Pant, pant… Just… a little… farther… to… FUCHSIA…
My bug PokéMON are tough. Prepare to lose!
If you walk in tall grass wearing shorts, do you get nicks and cuts?
Why don't girls like bug PokéMON?
I feel so much lighter in water.
What an impressive collection of GYM BADGES. We should battle!
I guess it's im- possible to swim all the way to JOHTO.
Hi! I was just going to put some sun block on.
Land ho! Gotta keep going!
I'm bored by fish- ing. Let's battle!
Beat the six of us trainers to win a fabulous prize! Think you've got what it takes?
I'm second. Now it's serious!
Here's No. 3! I won't be easy.
I'm No. 4! Getting tired?
OK! I'm No. 5. I'll stomp you!
I'm the last in line, but I tell you, I'm tough!
Mufufufu… I have nothing to do with the six- pack trainers. I waited here to beat you when you were tired out by all the battles.
I'm making my final preparations for the PokéMON LEAGUE.
By experiencing tough battles, you gain power.
Since you've come this far, you must be good. I'm going to give this battle every- thing I've got!
I lost to a train- er named [rival]. He was really strong, but… It was as if he absolutely had to win at any cost. I felt sorry for his PokéMON.
Wow, look at all those BADGES! I'm impressed. But you're not satisfied by just collecting them, right?
I'm feeling great today! I feel like I could boot even the LEAGUE CHAMP!
You look pretty strong. Let me battle you!
Hm? You're good, aren't you?
You shouldn't underestimate the wild PokéMON in these parts.
It's rare to see anyone come here. Are you training on your own?
Don't say a thing! Let me guess what you're thinking. Mmmmmmm… I got it! You're on the PokéMON LEAGUE challenge!
Tweet! Tweet! Tetweet!
Ah! The weather's as fine as ever.
quote.defeat: It's sunny, but I'm all wet…

quote.pre: Hmmm… I don't know what to do…
I can run like the wind!
Step right up and take a look!
I just lost, so I'm trying to find more PokéMON. Wait! You look weak! Come on, let's battle!
quote.defeat: Ugh. I don't have any more PokéMON.

quote.pre: You're a PokéMON trainer, right? Then you have to battle!
Instead of a bug PokéMON, I found a trainer!
I caught a bunch of PokéMON. Let me battle with you!
Whoa! You made me lose that fish!
I'm a good angler, but an even better trainer!
quote.defeat: Tch! I tried to rush things…

quote.pre: My PokéMON? Freshly caught!
I haven't seen you around before. So you think you are pretty tough?
I found some good PokéMON in the grass! I think they'll do it for me!
quote.defeat: Darn. I thought I could win.

quote.pre: That glance… It's intriguing.
Uh-huh. Yeah, and you know… Pardon? Battle? I'm on the phone. Oh, all right. But make it fast.
That BADGE! It's from VIOLET CITY! You beat FALKNER?
quote.defeat: I know what my weaknesses are.

quote.pre: I came through the tunnel, but I still have plenty of energy left.
quote.defeat: Whoa, boy! You've got more zip.

quote.pre: I'm confident in my ability to raise PokéMON. Want to see?
quote.defeat: I didn't do a good enough job?

quote.pre: This is where I do my training!
I'm the best in my class at PokéMON.
quote.defeat: No! There are bet- ter trainers…

quote.pre: Are you a trainer? Let's have a practice battle.
quote.defeat: Oh, no! I just can't win…

quote.pre: I just got my PokéMON back from DAY-CARE. Let's see how much stronger it got!
quote.defeat: Why does it end this way?

quote.pre: IRENE: Kyaaah! A boy found us!
JENN: You can't beat IRENE and go unpunished!
KATE: You sure were mean to my little sisters!
quote.defeat: KATE: No! I can't believe I lost.

quote.pre: I've been getting PokéMON data off my radio. I think I'm good.
I'm gonna show my girlfriend I'm hot stuff!
quote.defeat: I wish you would have lost for me…

quote.pre: My boyfriend's weak, so I can't rely on him.
Are you going to the GYM? Me too!
What kinds of Poké BALL do you use?
I'm practicing my fire breathing.
quote.defeat: Ow! I scorched the tip of my nose!

quote.pre: I'll go anywhere if bug PokéMON appear there.
quote.defeat: I see. So you battle that way.

quote.pre: Behold my graceful BALL dexterity!
I'm going to read your thoughts!
Thanks to my stud- ies, I'm ready for any PokéMON!
ANN: ANNE and I are in this to- gether!
ANNE: ANN and I are in this to- gether!
PokéMON can't do a thing if they are asleep. I'll show you how scary that is!
Let me try some- thing I learned today.
quote.defeat: I didn't study enough, I guess.

quote.pre: Are you good at training? If you are, could you show me how?
quote.defeat: I see. So you can battle that way.

quote.pre: Fly high into the sky, my beloved bird PokéMON!
quote.defeat: I feel like just flying away now.

quote.pre: Hi! Aren't you a cute trainer! May I see your PokéMON?
quote.defeat: I'm glad I got to see your PokéMON!

quote.pre: I've been over- seas, so I know about all sorts of PokéMON!
I just got back to OLIVINE. So how about a PokéMON battle?
Would you mind if I bragged about my PokéMON?
Such darling PokéMON. Let's show our PokéMON together at the same time.
Let me see what your PokéMON are capable of.
There's been news of an incident at the POWER PLANT.
I have a feeling that I can win. Let's see if I'm right!
Um… I…
You have to warm up before going into the water. That's basic.
A young guy like you should swim. Don't SURF on your PokéMON.
Are you going to CIANWOOD? How about a quick battle first?
No inner tube for me. I'm hanging on to a sea PokéMON!
The water's warm here. I'm loose and limber. Sure, I'll take you on!
I'm a bit tired. If I win, lend me your PokéMON.
See those islands that are blocked by whirlpools? There just has to be a secret!
quote.defeat: What's the secret to your strength?

quote.pre: The waves are wild here. They tire you out while you swim.
Are you seeking the secrets of WHIRL ISLANDS?
I'm on my way to WHIRL ISLANDS. I'm going explor- ing with friends.
quote.defeat: Is that how you do it?

quote.pre: You look so ele- gant, riding your PokéMON.
The weather is so beautiful, I'm in a daze!
If you need to rest, just tread water. You'll get your wind back, so you can keep on going strong.
quote.defeat: Oh! You have more energy than I do.

quote.pre: At night, STARYU gather near the water's surface.
Let me demonstrate the power of the PokéMON I caught!
Ah, it's good to be outside! I feel so free!
HEY! This is my secret place! Get lost, you outsider!
quote.defeat: I should have used my MOON STONE…

quote.pre: I love PokéMON! That's why I started--and why I'll keep on col- lecting PokéMON!
quote.defeat: How could you do this to me?

quote.pre: Hey! Do you have any rare PokéMON?
quote.defeat: Oh, my poor Poké- MON! Darlings!

quote.pre: Would you get this? Some [rival] guy made fun of my PokéMON! Darn it! My Poké- MON's great!
quote.defeat: My NIDOKING did pretty right on!

quote.pre: I'm in a slump. Maybe it's the gear I'm using. Let's battle for a change of pace!
quote.defeat: I lost, but I feel better anyway.

quote.pre: Are you going to LAKE OF RAGE too? Let's play for a little while!
I can do so much with my PokéMON-- it's super-fun!
Aack! You made me lose a POLIWAG! What are you going to do about it?
I fish until I can't anymore. I also battle until I drop. That's my relationship with my PokéMON.
I'm gonna win, for sure!
I'll do anything to get my hands on rare PokéMON!
quote.defeat: Oooh, your PokéMON are so appealing.

quote.pre: Do you know about the legendary bird PokéMON?
I can tell you're a good trainer by looking at you. I'm good at Poké- MON, and I can see that you are too.
quote.defeat: Tch! It's a total loss on my part.

quote.pre: You look strong. Good trainers seek tough opponents instinctively.
quote.defeat: Nope! This won't do at all.

quote.pre: Be prepared for anything! Let me see if your PokéMON have been raised properly!
Yo! You're spunky! But you know what? When it comes to sheer spunkiness, I'm the man!
My PokéMON are power packed!
Why do I climb mountains? Because they're there. Why do I train PokéMON? Because they're there!
I was training here alone. Behold the fruits of my labor!
What are your thoughts on rais- ing PokéMON?
What is your battle strategy? It is foolish to use strong moves indiscriminately.
Awright! I'll show you the power of mountain PokéMON!
quote.defeat: Mercy! You showed me your power!

quote.pre: I'm raising Poké- MON too! Will you battle with me?
I raise PokéMON too! Let's battle!
We're the KANTO PokéMON FEDERATION trainer group. We'll drive you under our wheels!
The cops shut down our UNDERGROUND PATH! That really fries me!
We're the KANTO PokéMON FEDERA- TION! Right on, dude!
How does the MAG- NET TRAIN work?
quote.defeat: I just want to see the MAGNET TRAIN…

quote.pre: We can't do with- out electricity. The POWER PLANT supplies us with electricity.
I came to explore ROCK TUNNEL.
Have you ever been to a picnic? They're so much fun!
Hey, you! Don't litter!
quote.defeat: I was just point- ing out…

quote.pre: People shouldn't leave any litter behind.
She'll be coming 'round MT.SILVER when she comes… MT.SILVER is in JOHTO, right?
I'll tell you a secret. But first, we battle!
Hmmm… This is a strange place.
The power of all those you defeated comes to me!
Psychic power is the power of your soul.
quote.defeat: Your soul has more power than mine!

quote.pre: Fufufufu… I see it clearly. I can see into your soul!
quote.defeat: Though I read you, I still lost…

quote.pre: The FIGHTING DOJO next door was once this city's GYM.
Darn! I was stand- ing guard up top when some old coot yelled at me. He startled me so much that I fell down here. I think I'll vent my anger by taking it out on you!
quote.defeat: Arrgh! This is NOT my day!

quote.pre: What do you want? If you interrupt our work, don't expect any mercy!
quote.defeat: You did OK today, brat, but wait 'til next time!

quote.pre: Quit taking SLOW- POKETAILS? If we obeyed you, TEAM ROCKET's rep would be ruined!
Stop taking TAILS? Yeah, just try to defeat all of us!
We stand guard in this tower. Here, we express our gratitude to honor all PokéMON.
However hard we battle, the TOWER will stand strong.
quote.defeat: I fought hard but I'm too weak.

quote.pre: …Sway like leaves in the wind…
I train to find enlightenment in PokéMON!
Let me see how much you trust your PokéMON.
The ELDER's HM lights even pitch- black darkness.
quote.defeat: It is my head that is bright!

quote.pre: Heheh. Feeling lucky, punk? Go ahead, take another step. We've got traps set in the floor!
This was once a ninja hideout. There are traps to confound intruders like you.
The door won't open? Well, duh. It has to have a password that only TEAM ROCKET knows.
Oh, a kid? I don't really like this, but eliminate you I must.
You rotten little pest!
Do I know the password? Maybe. But no weakling's going to get it!
quote.defeat: All right. Stop. I'll tell you.

quote.pre: Hyuck-hyuck-hyuck! You're challenging me to a battle? Hah! You're nuts, but you have guts! I like that! If you can beat me, I'll tell you a password to the boss's room!
I used to work for SILPH, but now I run research for TEAM ROCKET. A meddlesome child like you needs to be punished.
quote.defeat: A mere tactical error cost me…

quote.pre: I don't care that PokéMON are hurt by our experiment.
quote.defeat: Thinking is my strong suit, not battling.

quote.pre: Whoa! What a surprise! I didn't expect to see anyone here!
I roam far and wide in search of PokéMON. Are you looking for PokéMON too? Then you're my collecting rival!
You're headed to AZALEA, are you? Let my PokéMON see if you are good enough to battle.
If it's light, a cave isn't scary. If you're strong, PokéMON aren't scary.
ZUBAT's SUPERSONIC keeps confusing my PokéMON. I'm seriously upset about that!
It's been a while since I last saw another person. Don't be shy. Let's battle!
What do you know! A visitor!
Who's there? Leave me and my PokéMON alone!
I came all the way here to conduct my PokéMON research. Let me demonstrate my findings in a real battle!
There are two kinds of people. Those who have style, and those who don't. What kind of person are you?
I'm in training. Care for a round?
quote.defeat: Aww, no! You're too good for me.

quote.pre: If the PokéMON I liked were there, I'd go anywhere. That's what a real trainer does.
quote.defeat: I'd rather pet my babies than this!

quote.pre: You're here to defeat LT.SURGE? Not if I can help it!
quote.defeat: Sorry I failed you, LT.SURGE, sir!

quote.pre: LT.SURGE recog- nized my potential with electric PokéMON. Think you can beat me?
I'm going to take you down! Prepare to be shocked!
The keyword is guts! Those here are training night and day to become bird PokéMON masters. Come on!
Let me see if you are good enough to face FALKNER!
